outcome_rationale: The development Pilot did not meet its frozen 12/12 technical gate: 11 outputs were valid and pilot-32-D1 contained conflicting q7 status and rationale. The 24 frozen held-out requests were therefore not started and no method contrast was assessed. Zero-call review also found an unstated q7 rounding convention, a q9 instruction cue, and a cost summary undercount for the invalid response.
results_summary: 12 DeepSeek provider calls were made with no retries. Eleven responses were valid after the recorded exact-echo parser correction; one Pair 32 D1 response is invalid for scoring because q7 status contradicts its reason and status_note. Returned model alias/fingerprint were stable; all calls returned HTTP 200 with usage. Reconciled peak-rate cost estimate was USD 0.054851448. No efficacy score or held-out result is reported.
review_finding: Self-review found no basis for an efficacy estimate: the 12/12 gate failed, the held-out set is untouched, q7 has an implicit rounding convention, q9 is cued by shared instructions, and the run summary omitted the cost of its invalid final response. The original response and summaries are preserved; the reconciled ledger includes every call. No independent critic reviewed this closure.
scientific_update: No scientific belief about the structured-audit hypothesis changes: the held-out comparison was not run. The pilot provides operational failure evidence and exposes q7 precision, q9 cueing, and cost accounting risks.
